output.title: Scheduling a Callback for a Caregiver Who Is Not an Authorized Caller
output.draft_text:
Question: Can a caregiver who is not authorized set up a callback?

Answer: Yes. A caregiver who is not listed as an authorized caller on the member's account may set a callback time only. Do not discuss or share any other account, prescription, or health information with the caregiver.

What to do:
1. Confirm whether the caller is listed as an authorized caller on the member's account using [system or screen used to check authorized callers].
2. If the caregiver is not listed, tell them you can schedule a callback but cannot discuss the member's account or prescriptions.
3. Collect the callback details: [required callback details, e.g., preferred date/time window, phone number, time zone].
4. Schedule the callback in [system or tool used to schedule callbacks] and document the interaction as [documentation or note requirements].
5. Let the caregiver know who will receive the callback: [whether the callback goes to the member, the caregiver, or either].

If the caregiver wants to become an authorized caller, direct them to [process or form for adding an authorized caller].

Sample script: "I can set up a callback time for you. Because you're not listed as an authorized caller on this account, I'm not able to discuss any account or prescription details today. [approved script language for explaining privacy limits]"
